simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁחִיס (H7823) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁחִיס (shâchîyç) means after-growth First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 19 29.

definitions.full: H7823. shachis or sachish סָחִישׁ noun [masculine] grain that shoots up of itself in 2nd year (√ unknown); — || סָפִיחַ , 2Kin 19:29 (= שָׁחִיס || Isa 37:30 ); on use of this for food, compare Strabo xi. 4, 3 (of Albanians).
definitions.rootNote: or סָחִישׁ ; from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout ;
